caption.en:text: Where AI compute and firms sit in China (indicative)
note.zh:text: 省级算力和企业数没有统一的权威口径，这里按公开报道和各省「人工智能 +」方案的目标折算成示意值（全国合计约 32 EFLOPS、2.2 万家企业），只看各省之间的相对结构，不看绝对水平；地图是抽稀后的示意轮廓。
note.en:text: Provincial compute and firm counts have no single authoritative definition, so these are indicative values converted from public reporting and provincial AI Plus targets (about 32 EFLOPS and 22,000 firms nationwide). Read the structure between provinces, not absolute levels. The map is a simplified, thinned outline.
source.zh:text: 工信部与各省「人工智能 +」行动方案公开数据整理；底图几何：阿里云 DataV.GeoAtlas 省级边界（抽稀后使用）
source.en:text: MIIT and provincial AI action plans; boundaries: DataV.GeoAtlas province outlines, simplified
